messages:
maya: Observing elevated provisioning failures for Dedicated GPU pools in us-west2 and high HTTP 502/504 from CDN edge nodes. Spike started ~10:12 UTC. Affected customers reporting timeouts for long-running generation jobs.
ajay: Logs show GCE instance creation API errors: "quotaExceeded: Insufficient resources in region" and intermittent network errors to GKE control plane.
sofia: GCP status page https://status.cloud.google.com/incident/compute/ shows networking egress congestion in us-west2. There's a concurrent CDN provider issue for US west edges (ticket 9821).
maya: Repro: attempting to create a p4d nodepool returns: `ERROR: 503 Service Unavailable - upstream connection timed out`
sofia: For Dedicated pools we see node provisioning stuck in provisioning->staging for >12m. Autoscaler has been trying to spin to meet capacity and hitting rate limits.
ajay: Immediate mitigation options: 1) shift routing for new jobs away from us-west2 to us-central1/us-east1 2) promote standby Dedicated capacity in us-east1 3) reduce concurrency/batch sizes for affected routes to lower scheduling pressure.
tim: Can we do a quick traffic shift policy? I can push a temporary route: `redwoodctl routes update --selector region=auto --fallback-region=us-central1 --max-inflight=8`
maya: Do it. Also, pause autoscale for us-west2 pools to prevent SRE hitting provider quotas and causing cascading retries.
sofia: Pausing now: `gcloud compute instance-groups managed set-autoscaling --no-autorepair --region us-west2` - done. Noting some customers are on Private deployments with KMS in us-west2; KMS calls are timing out too (HSM RPC errors).
rachel: Two enterprise customers in us-west2 just pinged support, worried about data residency if we failover to us-east. We need to offer opt-in temporary failover and capture consent.
ajay: For private deployments, we can fallback to replicated key in global KMS via: `/admin/kms/fallback enable --key-pair=replica-west-to-global` but that requires approval and audit logging.
maya: Ops-bot: create incident ticket and page oncall.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2025-3478. Paging oncall rotation.
sofia: Networking team confirms BGP flap at CDN provider caused peering congestion; GCP egress queues overloaded. They're recommending edge reroute + origin egress throttling.
ajay: Implemented origin-side rate limiting for non-critical customers and lowered default beam width for generation to reduce long tail. Script: `for r in $(cat routes.txt); do redwoodctl config set $r max_tokens=1024; done`
maya: Verified new routing rule: traffic for free-tier and non-enterprise redirected to us-central1. Enterprise and compliance-tagged traffic still pinned but with degraded service.
rachel: Communicated to two affected enterprise contacts: offered option A) temporary cross-region failover with signed data handling addendum, B) remain pinned and accept degraded throughput. Waiting on replies.
tim: Cost note: using standby Dedicated capacity in us-east1 will double incremental GPU burn while we run failover; we should toggle burst billing to on-demand for the short window. Finance aware?
rachel: Finance synced. We have runway for up to $40k additional cloud spend for the day if needed.
sofia: GCP has started partial remediation at network layer; peering latencies back to normal on some edges. Node provisioning success rates improving to ~85%.
ajay: Re-enabled scaled-up pool creation for us-west2 with conservative margins. Will keep autoscale paused for 20m to observe.
maya: Monitoring: token latency 95p down from 14s -> 6s after routing change for affected routes. Error rates down 60%.
ops-bot: Update: Incident INC-2025-3478 status -> mitigation in progress.
sofia: Postmortem owners? Assign to @sofia + @ajay for triage; @maya will handle rollout of improved routing policy.
rachel: I'll draft customer comms and the consent form for cross-region failover.
tim: Action items: 
- sofia: build automated fallback to replicate KMS keys across regions (ticketed)
- ajay: add transient capacity guardrails to prevent autoscaler thrash
- maya: bake an emergency route profile that reduces batch sizes and pins compliance traffic
All due EOD.
ajay: Quick note — we saw one private customer with HSM handshake failure that required manual rekey to replica. Need to log and create runbook.
maya: Closing loop: will keep incident open until all pinned enterprise customers confirm strategy or us-west2 fully healthy.
rachel: customer A accepted failover; customer B declined and will wait. Logged both decisions.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2025-3478 updated: last action at 1757126720.
maya: Thanks team. Postmortem will be scheduled tomorrow 15:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:
